system.description:
Your ability to shrug off harm has reached heights that beggar belief; fists, blades and bullets rebound from your hide as though it were beaten iron, and blows that would fell a lesser Cainite simply fail to land upon you at all.

You may perform a Simple Test to negate nonaggravated (bashing and lethal) wounds, conducting one test per wound incurred. If you win the test, you take no damage from that wound. The power is reflexive, costs nothing, and may be used against each wound as it is inflicted.
